summary: Comprehensive e2e testing of Garment Foundry B2B marketing site. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass (root, upload PNG, reject .exe, create quote with files, list quotes excludes _id, invalid email rejected, contact). Frontend: home loads with hero CTAs, quote 10-step wizard completes end-to-end with success screen, contact form submits with success toast, all 7 static pages (/about /capabilities /categories /process /sourcing /quality /faqs) render, FAQ accordion clickable, mobile menu toggle reveals all links (verified via screenshot).

issues: Success state renders with large empty vertical space below header — could be tightened, but reference id text is visible based on automated text-match heuristic

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/quotes returns 200 OK by default — typically POST-create should return 201 (per REST convention). Not blocking.
server.py: list_quotes hard-caps at 500 documents with no pagination; fine for MVP but flag for scale.
server.py: Email send is fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task — errors only logged, no retry/queue. Acceptable for marketing-site lead capture.
server.py: file size enforcement happens AFTER reading entire body into memory (await file.read()). For 10MB cap on a public endpoint, fine; for higher caps, switch to streaming.
server.py: /api/upload allow-list excludes common formats like 'svg' and 'tiff' that designers may submit — minor UX consideration.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth on this app
seed_data_creation: Pytest created TEST_-prefixed quote and contact records in MongoDB (db.quotes, db.contacts). Also a small 1x1 PNG uploaded to object storage under garment-foundry/quotes/{uuid}.png. Non-destructive, safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py covers all 6 endpoints (root, upload, files, quotes create/list, contact). Resend emails are best-effort and not asserted. Mobile nav uses different testids than 'nav-link-*' for the in-drawer links (visibility check returned 0/7) but the drawer itself opens correctly per screenshot — if main agent wants Playwright to assert link visibility, expose testids on drawer items.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs reproduced. All requested features behave as specified.
